status: DOZ-02 design keys; the remaining frames, the export and the Bevy wiring follow the execution brief; independent review pending
coordinates: as dozer_rig_h120.json: px from the rig origin O, x forward (mirror when facing left), y up; prop parts: px from the room's stop-frame rectangles (layout px, y down in the room file)

pitch.rule: each hull column moves up by round(amp * (2 - 6 * (x + 84) / 167)) px (half away from zero), x = the column's rig x; the tread, wheel and yoke stay on the floor

impact_stunned.hit_spark: vfx_hit_spark_metal at the tub lip crumple, tick 0
impact_stunned.steam_leak: steam burst (3 puffs, every 6 ticks) from the leak emitter, ticks 0..47
impact_stunned.stack: one black puff on tick 0, then none (the stack is knocked crooked)
impact_stunned.riders: lurch forward (DOZ-01 keys) offset by rider_seat_dy of the hull frame shown

disabled.steam_leak: one steam_0..steam_2 puff every 40 ticks (slow, thin)
disabled.driver: slumped hold (execution: the pot over his eyes)

stop_frame.anchor: the hanging mass rectangle's bottom-left pixel (falls with it); the pulley frame stays at the raised anchor in every state

frames.pulley: every state, at the raised anchor

frames.landed_hit: after a hit (the bar is in the wheel)

brace.anchor: the prop target rectangle's bottom-left pixel
